title: Integer Variable Array
prompt:
Declare an array of integers with the values 10, 20, 30. Print the array elements.
Sample Input: None
Sample Output: 10 20 30
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's how you can declare and print an array of integers in Python:

```python
# Declare an array (list) of integers with values 10, 20, 30
array = [10, 20, 30]

# Print the array elements
print(array)
```

When you run this code, it will output:

```
[10, 20, 30]
```

Each element in the array is printed with a space between them, which is why the output is `[10 20 30]`. If you want to print them on the same line without a space, you can use the `end` parameter in the `print()` function:

```python
array = [10, 20, 30]
print(*array, sep=' ')
```

This will output:

```
10 20 30
```
